Prevent configuration bugs by making it an error to call single-value GetArg on list options or GetArgs on single options.

result.summary: This pull request introduces the ALLOW_LIST flag to ArgsManager and enforces at runtime that options declared as lists can only be retrieved using GetArgs() rather than GetArg() or IsArgSet(). It updates option definitions across the codebase to annotate list options properly, adjusts call sites that previously queried list options incorrectly, and fixes edge-case parsing inconsistencies with options like -blockfilterindex.
result.problem: ArgsManager permitted calling single-value accessors on list options and multi-value accessors on scalar options. This caused subtle bugs where calling GetArg on a list returned the last command-line value but the first configuration-file value, and IsArgSet returned true on negated list options.

resolved_concerns: ajtowns suggested simplifying CheckArgFlags logic to avoid unnecessary masking of type flags, which the author implemented.
ajtowns asked about IsArgSet usage on -rpcauth, which was addressed by showing IsArgSet is broken on negated list options and splitting fixes into dedicated PRs.

result.card: This pull request introduces the ALLOW_LIST flag in ArgsManager to require that list options are fetched with GetArgs() and scalar options with GetArg(). It resolves confusing inconsistencies where calling single-value accessors on list arguments yielded different results between configuration files and the command line. The change is primarily an internal refactoring for developer safety and code hygiene across all option definitions. Reviewers have shown strong concept agreement, though progress has been deferred while waiting on base PR #16545.
